rationale: Global document repository: mine once for Montenegro financial-sector assessments rather than monitor continuously.
EBRD country page/Transition Report is a durable recurring assessment of Montenegrin banking regulation; url_verification failure is soft only.
Semi-annual CESEE bank lending survey is a recurring leading indicator of supervisory focus on Montenegro.
Sovereign rating research is valuable but S&P access status is unknown and typically registration-gated; human must clear access.
Moody's credit opinions cover banking-system health but sit behind registration/subscription.
Annual public AML risk index gives comparable Montenegro trajectory used by compliance teams.
Annual INCSR Vol II AML chapter is public, dated and recurring; directly in scope for bank/payment AML obligations.
Distinct assessor body with its own Montenegro evaluation cycle and dated compliance deadlines overlapping AML duties.
Single gov.me article on MONEYVAL outcome — useful evidence, but the gov.me parent/news feed is the monitorable source.
Legacy FIU (uspn) gov.me section superseded by the FOJ site already captured; verify which URL is live.
Low-volume specialist digest that flags new MONEYVAL/GRECO Montenegro reports early with links to primaries.
Continuous local-language investigative feed capturing pre-decision politics of AML/regulatory processes.
Primary Montenegrin AML/CFT authority site for obliged entities including banks, payment institutions and e-money issuers.
Operational obliged-entity hub sits under the FIU site already monitored, but must be crawled as a high-value sub-path.
Independent capital-market regulator publishing regulations, registers and warnings relevant to banks' investment services.
Dated draft-rule consultation directory is the earliest signal of forthcoming obligations and comment deadlines.
AML section of the capital-market authority site; distinct supervisory stream but covered by crawling the parent domain.
National DPA publishing opinions, decisions and registries that bind banks and payment firms directly.
Year-foldered decisions archive under the AZLP site; high-value enforcement path within the monitored parent.
AML guidance page within the insurance supervisor's site; distinct stream but covered by the parent domain.
Inspectorate publishing recurring work programmes and reports on consumer-protection enforcement touching financial services.
Ministry of Finance consultations page carries financial-sector draft laws and deadlines before implementing acts appear.
Public integrity registers are the domestic PEP/EDD reference for Montenegrin banks; continuously updated.
MONEYVAL follow-up cycle is the strongest forward indicator of AML demands on banks and payment firms.
Main consumer NGO with ongoing campaigns signalling complaint themes and pressure on financial services; credibility moderate.
Single consultation-report PDF at a document endpoint — evidence and a harvesting pattern, not a producing source.
Tax/customs authority imposes FATCA/CRS reporting duties on financial institutions; thin coverage warrants manual confirmation.
